question: Do pinecone-inference, weaviate-embeddings and qdrant-cloud-inference stay separate records of the inference topic, or fold into databases-kv/pinecone, databases-kv/weaviate-cloud and databases-kv/qdrant-cloud?
why: each draft is the inference product of a vendor whose vector-database free tier is already a record without a tier label, so the integrator may fold the draft into that record as further evidence; the inference offers have their own limits (Pinecone 5M tokens a month per model and 500 rerank requests a month; Weaviate 2,000 embedding requests per cluster per day; Qdrant free models with no stated cap) that a reader asking for embedding APIs looks for under inference. The pricing and limits pages of Pinecone also disagree on pinecone-rerank-v0 for Starter.
